spans.s:
śuná, a. grown, prosperous, fortunate; as
n. [cf. 1176a], growth, prosperity; luck.
[perhaps fr. √śū, 1177a.]

śundhyú, f. -yū́ [355c], a. pure; unblemished;
 fair. [√śundh, 1165b.]

su-nāsākṣibhruva, a. having beautiful
noses-and-eyes-and-brows. [for nāsākṣibhrū
(1315c), i. e. nāsā + akṣi + bhrū,
1253.]

su-niścaya, a. having a very firm resolve,
 very resolute.

sūnára, f. -ī, a. gladsome, joyous. [cf.
sūnṛ́tā.]

sūnú, m. son; once (at 57^5), as f. daughter.
[√sū: cf. Church Slavonic synŭ, AS.
sunu, Eng. son: for mg, cf. 2suta.]

sūnṛ́ta, a. joyous, gladsome, kind; -ā,
as f. joy. [sūnára: see 1237^3.]

sūnṛtāvan, f. -varī, a. joyous. [sūnṛ́tā,
1234 and ^3: for fem., 1169. 2^2.]
